svg.title: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two thick violet resist blocks stand on a very thick blanket metal stack. After it the resist is gone and the metal remains only under where it was: two thick metal shapes with vertical edges, each over a filled hole, with bare pale oxide between them.
svg.desc: Two cross-sections of the upper films, one above the other, cut off at the bottom. Before the step two thick violet resist blocks stand on a very thick blanket metal stack. After it the resist is gone and the metal remains only under where it was: two thick metal shapes with vertical edges, each over a filled hole, with bare pale oxide between them.
svg.text: Before: thick resist on the metal-5 stack (step 162)
The cap is broken through, then chlorine etches the thick
metal between the resist shapes; the resist is stripped.
The lower part of the slice is not drawn.
Not to scale. Thin films are drawn thicker than they are.
